schema_notes.source_manifest_note: The source manifest is a mixed vi_vn + pt_br export. This audit manifest isolates the corrected pt_br STS evaluation scope.
schema_notes.sts_backend_interpretation: gpt-realtime-2 is an end-to-end speech-to-speech backend. llm_ttft_ms and llm_first_segment_ms are not applicable. Use tts_first_audio_ms as first playable audio approximation and total_response_ms as full response completion.

cleaning_rules.rating_scale: 0-6, where 0 is worst and 6 is best
cleaning_rules.number_acceptable_match: raw export initially equals exact_match; audit table adds normalized_exact_match for amount/date/phone/digit equivalence

known_limitations: voice, instructions, instructions hash, and input mode were not recorded in the source export
the source export directory also contains vi_vn data; this audit only counts language_mode=pt_br
issue sample audio files are referenced by server paths but are not included in this repository, so manual relistening is still pending
